title: TSMC and Synopsys Bring cuLitho to Production
body: TSMC and Synopsys went into production with NVIDIA's cuLitho computational lithography platform, accelerating semiconductor manufacturing by 40-60x over CPU methods.

context.text: TSMC and NVIDIA Transform Semiconductor Manufacturing With Accelerated Computing
why: cuLitho entering production with TSMC materially accelerates NVIDIA's advanced chip manufacturing and supply scalability.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA announces Blackwell Ultra and Vera Rubin at GTC 2025
body: At GTC 2025 on March 18, 2025, NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipping second half of 2025, Vera Rubin for 2026, and Feynman chips expected in 2028.

context.text: NVIDIA Expands AI Dominance With New Chips: Should You Buy the Stock?
why: NVIDIA extended its AI hardware roadmap through 2028, resetting customer expectations and long-term demand visibility.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA launches Newton and Isaac GR00T N1.6
body: NVIDIA announced the open-source Newton Physics Engine in Isaac Lab and the Isaac GR00T N1.6 model as part of an open accelerated robotics platform at CoRL in Seoul.

context.text: Nvidia Smashes 52-Week High As Robots And AI Take Off - NVIDIA  ( NASDAQ:NVDA )
why: NVIDIA launched a unified open-source robotics platform that opens a new large-scale humanoid robot training and deployment market.
date evidence (day)

title: US allows Nvidia H200 exports to China
body: On December 8, 2025, President Trump announced the US would allow Nvidia to ship H200 chips to China in exchange for a 25% fee on such sales.

context.text: Silicon Thaw: Alibaba Shares Surge as U.S. Eases Path for Nvidia’s H200 Chips into China
why: The US reversal of export controls let Nvidia resume China H200 sales under a new fee, reopening a major market.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA invests $5 billion in Intel
body: NVIDIA announced it would invest $5 billion in Intel common stock at $23.28 per share to develop AI infrastructure and PC products.

context.text: Tim Cook, Jensen Huang, Lisa Su Were Reportedly Warned Of Potential China Move On Taiwan By 2027 - NVIDIA  ( NASDAQ:NVDA )
why: A $5 billion commitment to Intel could secure alternative supply and reshape NVIDIA's manufacturing and geopolitical risk profile.
date evidence (day)

title: Nvidia launches Nemotron 3 Super, $26B AI bet
body: Nvidia released the Nemotron 3 Super open-weight model and committed $26 billion over five years to open-source AI model development.

context.text: Nvidia Drops Nemotron 3 Super Amid $26 Billion Open-Model AI Bet-America's Answer to Qwen?
why: Marked NVIDIA's major strategic commitment to open-weight AI models with a $26B multi-year investment.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA unveils Vera Rubin at GTC 2026
body: NVIDIA announced the Vera Rubin platform with Rubin GPU and HBM4 at GTC 2026 on March 16, 2026.

context.text: Nvidia GTC 2026 Kicks Off in San Jose, Igniting a Tech-Wide Rally as 'Rubin' Architecture and Physical AI Take Center Stage
why: Unveiled the next-generation Vera Rubin architecture that defines NVIDIA's data center GPU roadmap beyond Blackwell.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA launches Vera CPU for agentic AI
body: NVIDIA launched the Vera CPU on March 16, 2026, a processor purpose-built for agentic AI with $20B standalone CPU revenue visibility and a $200B addressable market cited by CFO in May 2026.

context.text: Nvidia has a $200 Billion Warning for AMD and Intel Stock Investors
why: Selling Vera server CPU standalone opens a new $200B market and repositions NVDA's data-center product strategy.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA Q1 FY27 revenue $81.6B, $80B buyback
body: NVIDIA reported fiscal Q1 revenue of $81.6 billion and announced an $80.0 billion share repurchase authorization with a dividend increase to $0.25 per share.

context.text: Nvidia earnings live updates: The key numbers to watch for in the report
why: Record Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6B and an $80B buyback reset NVDA's earnings and capital return outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA-IREN 5GW AI infrastructure partnership and cloud contract
body: NVIDIA and IREN announced a strategic partnership to deploy up to 5GW of DSX-aligned AI infrastructure with warrants for 30 million shares and a separate $3.4B five-year managed GPU cloud contract.

context.text: Why IREN Limited Rallied Almost 40% in May
why: The 5GW IREN partnership with a $3.4B cloud contract and warrants materially expands NVIDIA's infrastructure reach and revenue visibility.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin enters full production
body: NVIDIA announced the Vera Rubin platform is ramping into full production for agentic AI factories, with production shipments set to begin this fall.

context.text: NVIDIA Vera Rubin Ramps Into Full Production to Power Agentic AI Factories Worldwide - NVIDIA  ( NASDAQ:NVD
why: Vera Rubin entering full production marks the start of NVIDIA's next-gen AI platform shipments that will drive future data center revenue.
date evidence (day)

title: Nvidia unveils RTX Spark N1X PC processor
body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced the RTX Spark superchip, also referred to as N1X, an Arm-based PC processor pairing a Blackwell GPU with a custom Grace CPU, at Computex in Taipei on June 1, 2026.

context.text: QCOM Stock Slides Premarket: Qualcomm's Dragonfly AI Push Gets Overshadowed By Nvidia's Computex Blitz
why: NVIDIA's first PC processor challenges Qualcomm in AI PCs and expands its addressable market beyond GPUs.
date evidence (day)

title: Nvidia-Firmus 170,000 GPU AI factory partnership
body: Nvidia partnered with Firmus Technologies on a strategic compute partnership through 2034 covering up to 170,000 GPUs and expected US$25–30 billion in offtake agreements over six years, anchored by a 360 MW AI factory campus in Batam, Indonesia.

context.text: Australia's Firmus Technologies strikes AI access deal with Nvidia
why: The $30B six-year Firmus cloud deal is a major commitment that significantly expands NVIDIA's AI computing distribution.
date evidence (month)

title: Japan and NVIDIA launch national AI infrastructure
body: NVIDIA partnered with Japan's METI and Noetra Corp. to launch the world's first national Physical AI factory with 13,750 Vera CPUs and 27,500 Rubin GPUs for the FRONTia Project.

context.text: Japan Government, Industrial Leaders and NVIDIA Launch the World’s First National AI Infrastructure
why: Launching the world's first national Physical AI factory with Japan's METI establishes a sovereign AI template using Vera Rubin at scale.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA-SK Group $500B AI partnership announced
body: NVIDIA and SK Group signed letters of intent for a $500-billion-plus initiative spanning AI factories and next-generation AI memory including HBM4.

context.text: SK Group and NVIDIA Expand Strategic Partnership Across AI Factories and Next-Generation Memory
why: A $500B-plus partnership with SK Group materially expands NVIDIA's AI factory and HBM4 memory outlook in South Korea.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA invests in Safe Superintelligence partnership
body: NVIDIA announced a long-term strategic partnership and investment in Safe Superintelligence Inc., with Reuters and Bloomberg reporting a $5 billion equity commitment and access to Vera Rubin expanding SSI's compute by an order of magnitude.

context.text: Ilya Sutskever's Safe Superintelligence raises $5 billion from Nvidia despite not yet releasing a product
why: A $5B investment in Safe Superintelligence with Vera Rubin access ties NVIDIA to a leading frontier AI lab and large compute demand.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA $500B AI infra financing with asset managers
body: NVIDIA partnered with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure financing platforms.

context.text: NVIDIA Partners With Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to Establish AI Compute Infrastructure Financing Platforms to Mobilize Over $500 Billion of Third-Party Capital
why: Partnering with six major asset managers to mobilize $500B in third-party AI infrastructure capital reshapes NVIDIA's financing and sales model.
date evidence (day)

title: AWS and NVIDIA announce 2 million GPU expansion
body: AWS and NVIDIA announced on August 26, 2026 a plan to deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS global infrastructure in 2027-2028, with potential Vera CPU purchases.

context.text: Nvidia May Have Just Eliminated Its Biggest Risk
why: AWS committing to 2 million additional GPUs through 2028 secures a massive multi-year demand anchor for NVIDIA.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9B
body: NVIDIA announced on September 3, 2026 that it agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion.

context.text: On theCUBE Pod: Nvidia rules, Mythos has ChatGPT moment
why: A $12.9B acquisition of Hugging Face would materially expand NVIDIA's AI software footprint and platform control.
date evidence (day)

title: Nvidia guides FY2028 revenue up 70%
body: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress guided fiscal 2028 revenue to grow about 70% on its Q2 earnings call, with third-party analysis implying roughly $700B, citing supply-constrained demand visibility.

context.text: Jensen Huang Just Sent a Signal That Could Matter More Than the September Effect
why: CEO guided FY2028 revenue to ~$700B with 70% growth, resetting long-term investor expectations for the business.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA invests $3.5B in MediaTek, expands NVLink Fusion
body: NVIDIA invested $3.5 billion in MediaTek convertible bonds and MediaTek adopted the NVLink Fusion platform for custom XPUs in rack-scale AI factories.

context.text: NVIDIA and MediaTek Deepen Long-Standing Partnership to Build AI Edge to Cloud Computing Platforms
why: NVIDIA invested $3.5B in MediaTek and expanded NVLink Fusion, extending its platform into custom XPUs and rack-scale AI factories.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA announces $150B buyback increase to $235B
body: NVIDIA's Board authorized a $150 billion increase to its share repurchase program, raising the remaining total authorization to $235 billion, expected to be executed through fiscal year 2028.

context.text: Nvidia Adds $150 Billion to Massive Stock Buyback, the Largest Ever
why: NVIDIA authorized the largest share buyback in history, materially signaling confidence and returning capital to shareholders.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA launches Open Agent Safety Platform
body: NVIDIA announced the Open Agent Safety Platform with OpenShell and Sentry to enforce full-stack governance and control for AI agents across software and hardware.

context.text: Nvidia debuts enhanced safety controls to rein in rogue AI agents
why: NVIDIA launched an open-source agent safety platform, establishing a new software control layer for its AI compute ecosystem.
date evidence (day)
